method.kind: local V8 active sample deltas; not Cloudflare CPU metering
method.fresh: Each stage is first use in a separate fresh workerd process; input comes from prior process output. Every calculation batch is included.
method.warm: Two sequential complete 30-cycle suites; no concurrent tests/profile processes.
method.zeroSamples: Zero estimates mean no active samples were observed, not zero Worker CPU.
method.outlierHandling: All estimates retained; V8 deltas cannot separate CPU from host descheduling or native-call waits.

over10.profileUnavailable: Repeated inheritance phases overwrote that per-iteration profile; filenames now also include the followup step. Estimate retained unchanged.
